Title: Valid login
Test Steps: Enter username; Enter password; Click Login

Title: Invalid login
Test Steps: Enter valid username; Enter wrong password; Click Login
Expected Result: Error message is displayed and user remains logged out

Title: Empty username
Test Steps: Leave username blank; Enter password; Click Login

Title: Empty password
Test Steps: Enter username; Leave password blank; Click Login

Title: Search matching book
Test Steps: Enter a known title; Click Search

Title: Search with no match
Test Steps: Enter an unknown title; Click Search

Title: Empty search
Expected Result: Application remains stable and displays available books or validation

Title: Borrow available book
Precondition: User is logged in and book is available
Expected Result: Book becomes borrowed and confirmation is displayed

Title: Borrow unavailable book
Precondition: User is logged in and book is unavailable

Title: Borrow confirmation
Expected Result: Confirmation is displayed and state is updated

Title: Return borrowed book
Expected Result: Book becomes available again and confirmation is displayed
